description:
## Why

Reframe `Markdown.Stream` from "lex-state cache" to "render-state holder." The output unit is rendered ANSI lines, not AST blocks. Per render call, only the *pending* tail is freshly lexed and rendered; previously-emitted lines are cached as iolist and never re-walked. Width and theme become part of the cache key.

This subsumes the deferred `opi-4dx.4` (line cache for finalized messages): a finalized message has zero pending tail, so subsequent renders are O(1).

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown/stream.ex` — current `Markdown.Stream`; gets rewritten or replaced.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown.ex` — currently exposes `render_blocks_to_lines/4`; should become internal.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown/lexer.ex` — invoked only on the pending tail.

## Shape

```
%Markdown.Render{
  source:    binary,           # text seen so far
  checkpoint: non_neg_integer, # byte offset; everything before is committed
  committed: iolist,           # cached output for source[0..checkpoint-1], newest-head
  width:     pos_integer,
  theme_id:  term              # invalidate when this changes
}
```

API:
- `new(theme, width) :: t`
- `put(t, full_source) :: t` — extends source; on prefix-extension, does not reset
- `render(t) :: {iolist, t}` — returns lines for the *new* tail since last render and a state with that tail folded in; the iolist is just the new bytes' lines, not committed
- `committed_iolist(t) :: iolist` — for the caller assembling final output
- `resize(t, new_width) :: t` — clears committed, re-runs over full source
- `retheme(t, new_theme_id) :: t` — same

Internal: `committed` is stored newest-head (`[newest_seg | ... | oldest_seg]`). Promotion appends with `[new_seg | committed]` — O(1). Output assembly is `[older, new]` nested iolist; terminal flatten produces correct order.

## Acceptance

- Per `render/1` call on a finalized state (no pending tail) returns `{[], state}` and does no lex work — verify via telemetry.
- Per `render/1` call on a streaming state does lex+render only on the pending tail (length-bounded by current paragraph).
- `resize/2` reruns rendering over full source once; subsequent renders return `{[], _}`.
- No `++` on `committed`; no `Enum.reverse` on the hot path.
- Output is byte-equal to the current pipeline at the same width/theme — golden tests.

## Tests

- Pure unit tests on the new module covering: byte-by-byte growth, paragraph promotion, fence-spanning, width-change-triggers-rerun, finalized-render-is-noop.
- Golden test: render same source via current pipeline and via `Markdown.Render` at a fixed width — assert byte-equal.

## Out of scope

- Wiring into `AssistantMessage` (that lives in `opi-4dx.10`).
